results.title: Section 232 Tariffs — Steel, Aluminum, Autos (2026)
results.content: Section 232 tariffs are largely unavoidable by switching countries, but the rate depends on the tier: 50% on articles wholly of steel, aluminum, or copper, and 25% on derivative products substantially made of those metals (both on full customs value since the April 6, 2026 restructuring), plus 25% on autos. The UK pays a reduced 25% on steel/aluminum under the EPD, and Australia is exempt.
